ei.title: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass...
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand ①<u>comfortably</u> upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass ②<u>was</u> over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs ③<u>could standing</u> on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were ④<u>reduced</u>, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ could standing → could stand: 조동사 could 뒤에는 동사원형. standing(분사)은 불가
det.analysis:
✅ ① comfortably — stand comfortably upright에서 부사로 동사 수식, 적절
✅ ② was — the centre of mass was over the hips에서 단수 주어 동사, 적절
❌ ③ could standing → could stand — 조동사(could) + 동사원형(stand) 구문. could standing은 문법 위반 ←정답
✅ ④ reduced — were reduced에서 수동태 과거분사, 적절
det.tip: 조동사(can/could/will 등) + 동사원형. 분사(-ing/-ed) 불가.

Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are ④<u>easier</u> to move if they are more slender towards the ends. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① It taking → It takes: 가주어 구문에서 정동사(takes)가 필요. taking(분사)은 주절 동사 불가
det.analysis:
❌ ① It taking → It takes — 가주어 It + 본동사(takes) 구문. 분사 taking은 정동사 역할 불가 ←정답
✅ ② upright — stand comfortably upright에서 형용사/부사, 적절
✅ ③ counterbalanced — was counterbalanced by에서 수동태 과거분사, 적절
✅ ④ easier — Legs are easier to move에서 비교급 형용사 보어, 적절
det.tip: 주절에는 반드시 정동사(현재/과거형). 분사(-ing)는 정동사 불가.

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever ①<u>themselves</u> upwards onto their hindlimbs. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and ③<u>thin</u>. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as ④<u>to grasp</u> prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ to grasp → grasping: such as 뒤에는 동명사(~ing). to부정사는 such as 구문에 부적합
det.analysis:
✅ ① themselves — lever themselves upwards에서 재귀대명사, 적절
✅ ② relatively — a relatively short body에서 부사(형용사 수식), 적절
✅ ③ thin — grow their hindlimbs long and thin에서 형용사 보어, 적절
❌ ④ to grasp → grasping — such as ___ prey items: such as 뒤에는 동명사(-ing형)가 오는 것이 정상. to부정사는 such as와 호응하지 않음 ←정답
det.tip: such as + 동명사(-ing) / 명사. such as + to부정사는 비문.

questions.passage: Most habitually ①<u>four-footed</u> creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it ②<u>easy</u> for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a ③<u>long</u>, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping ④<u>prey</u> items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② easy(쉬운) → hard(어려운): 네 발 동물이 뒷다리로 서기 '어렵다'는 맥락. easy는 정반대
det.analysis:
✅ ① four-footed — '네 발 달린' 동물이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② easy → hard — This makes it ___ for them to stand comfortably upright. 네 발 동물은 에너지가 많이 들어 뒷다리로 서기 '어렵다(hard)'. easy는 맥락상 정반대 ←정답
✅ ③ long — a long, stiff tail에서 꼬리가 '긴'이라는 묘사, 적절
✅ ④ prey — grasping prey items에서 '먹이'를 잡는 활동, 적절
det.tip: hard(어려운) ↔ easy(쉬운). 맥락에서 에너지가 많이 드는 상황.

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively ①<u>long</u> body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, ②<u>stiff</u> tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more ③<u>slender</u> towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for ④<u>other</u> activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① long(긴) → short(짧은): 엉덩이 앞쪽의 몸체가 '비교적 짧은(relatively short)' 것이 긴 꼬리와 균형을 이룸
det.analysis:
❌ ① long → short — A relatively ___ body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail. 짧은(short) 몸체가 긴 꼬리로 균형. long이면 균형 논리가 깨짐 ←정답
✅ ② stiff — a long, stiff tail에서 꼬리가 '뻣뻣한'이라는 묘사, 적절
✅ ③ slender — more slender towards the ends에서 끝이 '가는', 적절
✅ ④ other — free for other activities에서 '다른' 활동, 적절
det.tip: short body ↔ long tail = counterbalance(균형)

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by __________. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a long, stiff tail behind(뒤쪽의 길고 뻣뻣한 꼬리): 짧은 몸과 균형을 이루는 요소
det.analysis:
❌ ① in the chest region — 가슴 부위는 네 발 동물의 질량 중심. 균형 대상이 아님
✅ ② a long, stiff tail behind — 짧은 몸 앞쪽이 '뒤쪽의 길고 뻣뻣한 꼬리'로 균형(counterbalanced) ←정답
❌ ③ their hindlimbs long and thin — 뒷다리 묘사. 균형 대상이 아님
❌ ④ other activities — 다른 활동은 손의 용도. 균형과 무관
det.tip: counterbalanced by = ~에 의해 균형이 잡힌

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer __________, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: required for running(달리기에 필요한): 앞다리가 '더 이상 달리기에 필요하지 않아' 축소되었다는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① required for running — 'The arms, no longer ___, were reduced'. no longer + 과거분사구: 달리기에 필요하지 않게 되어 축소 ←정답
❌ ② free for other activities — 자유로워진 것은 '손(hands)'이지 '앞다리(arms)' 전체의 상태가 아님
❌ ③ easier to move — 움직이기 쉬운 것은 '다리(legs)' 이야기
❌ ④ long and thin — 길고 가는 것은 '뒷다리(hindlimbs)' 특성
det.tip: no longer required = 더 이상 필요하지 않은. 축소(reduced)의 원인.

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 엉덩이를 받침점으로 힘 안 들이고 뒷다리로 섬 — 본문 6번째 문장과 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 공룡(over the hips)과 네 발 동물(chest region)의 질량 중심은 다름
❌ ② 네 발 동물은 '많은 에너지(a lot of energy)'가 필요. 거의 안 든다는 반대
✅ ③ 'With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort' — 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 대부분의 양막류는 '짧고 두꺼운(short, thick)' 다리. 길고 가는 것은 공룡
det.tip: fulcrum = 지렛대 받침점. without effort = 힘 안 들이고.

ch: 공룡의 질량 중심은 네 발 동물과 같은 위치에 있었다.
네 발 동물은 뒷다리로 서기 위해 에너지가 거의 들지 않는다.
공룡은 엉덩이를 지렛대 받침점으로 삼아 힘 안 들이고 뒷다리로 설 수 있었다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ '사용할 수 없었다'는 불일치 — 본문은 'the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing'으로 사용 가능했음
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'centre of mass in the chest region' — 일치
✅ ② 'A relatively short body forward of the hips' — 일치
✅ ③ '더 가늘면 움직이기 쉽고, 움직이기 쉬우면 빠르게 달리기 쉽다' — 일치
❌ ④ 본문: 손이 '다른 활동(사냥감 잡기, 등반)에 자유로웠다(left free)'. '사용할 수 없었다'는 정반대 ←정답
det.tip: left free for = ~을 위해 자유로운 상태로. 사용 가능했다는 뜻.

ch: 네 발 동물의 질량 중심은 가슴 부위에 있다.
공룡의 엉덩이 앞쪽 몸체는 비교적 짧았다.
다리 끝이 가늘수록 빠르게 달리기 쉽다.
공룡의 손은 사냥감을 잡거나 등반하는 데 사용할 수 없었다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 짧은 앞쪽 몸이 긴 꼬리와 균형 — 본문 5번째 문장과 정확히 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 꼬리는 '길고 뻣뻣한(long, stiff)'. 짧고 유연하다는 반대
❌ ② 공룡은 'without effort'로 쉽게 섬. 더 어렵다는 반대
❌ ③ 양막류는 '짧고 두꺼운(short, thick)' 다리. 반대
✅ ④ 'A relatively short body... was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail' — 일치 ←정답
det.tip: counterbalanced = 균형을 이루다. short body ↔ long tail.

ch: 공룡의 꼬리는 짧고 유연하여 균형을 잡았다.
공룡은 네 발 동물보다 뒷다리로 서기 더 어려웠다.
양막류의 다리는 가늘고 긴 것이 일반적이다.
공룡의 짧은 앞쪽 몸은 긴 꼬리와 균형을 이루었다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 공룡의 질량 중심→이족 보행→가는 다리→빠른 달리기→자유로운 손. 글 전체 주제
det.analysis:
✅ ① 질량 중심이 엉덩이에 → 이족 보행 용이 → 다리 가늘게 → 빠른 달리기 → 손 자유. 글 전체 흐름과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 유전적 원인은 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ③ 기후 변화 적응은 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ④ 서식지 분포는 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: 주제 = 질량 중심 위치가 결정한 공룡의 이족 보행 이점.

ch: 공룡이 질량 중심 위치 덕분에 갖게 된 이족 보행의 이점
네 발 동물이 이족 보행으로 진화하지 못한 유전적 원인
양막류의 다리 구조가 기후 변화에 적응한 과정
척추동물의 꼬리 형태에 따른 서식지 분포 양상

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 질량 중심 위치→구조적 이점(이족 보행, 가는 다리)+기능적 결과(빠른 달리기, 자유 손)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 현대 파충류는 본문에 없음. 양막류(amniotes)와의 비교만 있음
✅ ② 질량 중심(over the hips) → 이족 보행(without effort) → 가는 다리(long and thin) → 빠른 달리기 + 자유로운 손. 구조→기능 흐름 ←정답
❌ ③ 네 발 동물의 에너지 효율은 도입부 배경일 뿐 주제 아님
❌ ④ 멸종과 포유류 전이는 본문에 전혀 없음

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, <u>the hands left free for other activities</u>, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>the hands left free for other activities</u>이(가) 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 달리기에서 해방된 앞다리→사냥·등반 등 새로운 기능 수행: 밑줄 친 표현의 정확한 함축
det.analysis:
❌ ① 앞다리가 강해진 것이 아니라 '축소(reduced)'됨. 반대
❌ ② 퇴화하여 기능 없음이 아니라 '다른 활동에 자유'. 반대
✅ ③ 앞다리가 달리기에 불필요(no longer required for running) → 축소 → 손이 다른 활동(grasping prey, climbing)에 자유. 밑줄 표현의 함축 ←정답
❌ ④ 네 발 동물이 아니라 공룡의 이야기
det.tip: left free for = ~을 위해 자유로운 상태로 남겨진. 기능 전환의 의미.
